mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are waking up to overcast skies and a temperature of 55 degrees outside the Verona Public Library.

In city news, Public Works has announced that chip seal road treatments will begin on Wednesday, September 23rd, which will cause lane closures and traffic control on Cross Country Road and East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the Plan Commission will review several development projects at their October 5th meeting, and details are available for Envision Verona, the newly adopted comprehensive plan.

There are plenty of community events to look forward to. Today, you can attend Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, check out Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, or Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's. Later this week, look forward to the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and the Verona Fall Fest starting on September 25th.
In the weekly police recap, on Thursday, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for operating while intoxicated, second offence, which is an O W I, after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.
For your Culver's update, the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, but the location is closed today for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day to report.
